inputs.description: Rosbag name (will be suffixed with timestamp and saved under bags/)
X display number for GUI tasks (press Enter for default)

tasks.label: Launch: Livox (MID360)
args: -c
export COLCON_TRACE='' AMENT_TRACE_SETUP_FILES='' && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch robofi_bringup livox_lidar.launch.py xfer_format:=4
tasks.detail: Runs Livox MID360 driver with xfer_format=4 so both /livox/lidar (PointCloud2) and /livox/lidar_custom (Livox CustomMsg) are published via robofi_bringup

tasks.label: Launch: Livox RViz (MID360)
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch livox_ros_driver2 rviz_MID360_launch.py user_config_path:=${workspaceFolder}/src/livox_ros_driver2/config/MID360_config.json
tasks.detail: Runs Livox driver and RViz directly on DISPLAY :77 without xterm; uses the MID360 config.

tasks.label: Launch: RQT Image View
args: -lc
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 run rqt_image_view rqt_image_view
tasks.detail: Runs rqt_image_view directly on DISPLAY :77 to visualize camera/image topics

tasks.label: Launch: Tier IV C2-176 Camera
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run v4l2_camera v4l2_camera_node --ros-args -r __ns:=/camera -p video_device:=/dev/tieriv_c2_video0 -p image_size:="[2880, 1860]" -p pixel_format:=UYVY -p output_encoding:=bgr8 -p camera_frame_id:=camera_optical_frame -p camera_name:=tier4_c2_176 -p camera_info_url:=file://${workspaceFolder}/src/camera_lidar_fuse/config/tier4_c2_176_2880x1860.yaml -p use_sensor_data_qos:=true
tasks.detail: Launches Tier IV C2-176 fisheye camera publishing to /camera/image_raw topic (2880x1860 @ UYVY) using intrinsic from camera_lidar_fuse package. View with RQT Image View task.

tasks.label: Launch: RealSense D405 (PiPER Wrist Camera)
args: -lc
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch realsense2_camera rs_launch.py camera_name:=piper_gripper_d405
tasks.detail: Launches Intel RealSense D405 wrist camera on PiPER gripper. Publishes RGB to /piper_gripper_d405/color/image_raw and depth to /piper_gripper_d405/depth/image_rect_raw. View with RQT Image View task.

tasks.label: Launch: RealSense D435i
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch realsense2_camera rs_launch.py camera_name:=d435i device_type:=d435i usb_port_id:=2-3.4.1 enable_color:=true enable_depth:=true
tasks.detail: Launches Intel RealSense D435i camera (USB port 3-3.4.1). Publishes RGB to /d435i/color/image_raw and depth to /d435i/depth/image_rect_raw. View with RQT Image View task.

tasks.label: Launch: Camera-LiDAR Fuse
args: -lc
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch camera_lidar_fuse camera_lidar_fuse.launch.py
tasks.detail: Launches camera-LiDAR fusion projection node for projecting LiDAR points onto camera images. Subscribes to /livox/lidar and publishes projected points (with u,v) on /lidar_points_projected. Run 'Launch: Camera-LiDAR Fuse Overlay' alongside to visualize.

tasks.label: Launch: Camera-LiDAR Fuse Overlay
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && export PYTHONPATH=/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages:$PYTHONPATH && ros2 run camera_lidar_fuse projection_visualizer --ros-args -p image_topic:=/camera/image_raw -p projected_topic:=/lidar_points_projected -p output_image_topic:=/camera/projected_overlay -p image_encoding:=yuv422 -p force_yuv422:=true -p yuv422_layout:=uyvy -p slop:=0.1
tasks.detail: Overlays projected LiDAR points onto the Tier IV camera image. Subscribes to /camera/image_raw and /lidar_points_projected; publishes the fused overlay on /camera/projected_overlay. Requires 'Launch: Camera-LiDAR Fuse' and the Tier IV camera to be running. View output with RQT Image View.

tasks.label: Launch: Camera-LiDAR Fuse (Full Pipeline)
tasks.detail: Runs both the projection node and the overlay visualizer in parallel. Requires the Tier IV camera and Livox LiDAR to already be running (e.g. via 'Launch: Ranger Complete Bringup (Real)').

tasks.label: Launch: PiPER Arm Only
args: -lc
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch piper start_single_controller.launch.py can_port:=can_piper
tasks.detail: Launches PiPER 6-DOF arm ros2_control controller stack via piper package (CAN: can_piper). Loads hardware interface, spawns joint_state_broadcaster and piper_arm_controller. Provides /piper_arm_controller/follow_joint_trajectory action interface for motion planning.

tasks.label: Run: PiPER Initializer (CAN Control Mode)
args: -lc
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 run piper piper_initializer
tasks.detail: Runs the PiPER initializer node to recover CAN command control mode if the arm is stuck. Requires the PiPER driver to be running.

tasks.label: Display: Robot Model with GUI
args: -lc
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch ranger_description display.launch.py gui:=true
tasks.detail: Launches complete robot model (Ranger base + PiPER arm + sensors) in RViz with Joint State Publisher GUI on DISPLAY :77. Use sliders to move arm joints interactively.

tasks.label: Launch: Ranger Complete Bringup (Real)
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch robofi_bringup ranger_complete_bringup.launch.py backend:=real
tasks.detail: Launches the complete Ranger system on real hardware: base controller, LiDAR, cameras, PiPER arm, MoveIt on DISPLAY :77

tasks.label: Launch: Ranger Mock Bringup
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch robofi_bringup ranger_complete_bringup.launch.py backend:=mock
tasks.detail: Launches MoveIt demo with mock_components (no hardware, no Gazebo). Good for MoveIt planning/controller smoke tests on DISPLAY :77

tasks.label: Launch: Ranger Gazebo Simulation
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch robofi_bringup ranger_complete_bringup.launch.py backend:=gazebo launch_moveit:=false
tasks.detail: Launches Gazebo Fortress simulation: garden world, robot spawn, ros2_control controllers, and sensor bridges on DISPLAY :77. MoveIt is disabled in this task because the current workspace environment does not provide moveit_configs_utils.

tasks.label: Launch: Gazebo Sim (Direct, with Nav2)
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch ranger_sim sim_bringup.launch.py launch_nav:=true use_rviz:=true
tasks.detail: Launches Gazebo Fortress sim directly via ranger_sim package with Nav2 and RViz enabled on DISPLAY :77

tasks.label: Launch: Gazebo Sim (Headless CI)
args: -lc
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ros2 launch ranger_sim sim_bringup.launch.py headless:=true launch_moveit:=false
tasks.detail: Launches headless Gazebo Fortress sim (no GUI, no MoveIt) for CI smoke testing

tasks.label: FASTLIO2 Mapping Stack
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch robofi_bringup fastlio2_navigation.launch.py launch_nav2:=false launch_localizer:=false launch_octomap:=true rviz_config:=$(ros2 pkg prefix robofi_bringup)/share/robofi_bringup/rviz/fastlio2_mapping.rviz
tasks.detail: Launches complete Ranger system + FASTLIO2 LIO + Octomap Server on DISPLAY :77 for mapping, pinned to robofi_bringup/rviz/fastlio2_mapping.rviz

tasks.label: FASTLIO2 Navigation Stack
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch robofi_bringup fastlio2_navigation.launch.py launch_nav2:=true launch_localizer:=true launch_pgo:=false nav2_start_delay:=5.0 nav2_use_amcl:=false map_path:=${input:mapPath}
tasks.detail: Launches complete Ranger system + FASTLIO2 Localizer + Nav2 stack on DISPLAY :77 for autonomous navigation with saved map

tasks.label: FASTLIO2 Navigation Stack (Auto-Latest Map)
args: -lc

LATEST_MAP=$(find ${workspaceFolder}/maps/fastlio2 -name "map.pcd" -type f | sort -r | head -n1); source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch robofi_bringup fastlio2_navigation.launch.py launch_nav2:=true launch_localizer:=true launch_pgo:=false nav2_use_amcl:=false map_path:=$LATEST_MAP rviz_config:=$(ros2 pkg prefix robofi_bringup)/share/robofi_bringup/rviz/fastlio2_navigation.rviz
tasks.detail: Launches complete Ranger system + FASTLIO2 Localizer + Nav2 stack with the most recent saved map (auto-detected from maps/fastlio2/), pinned to robofi_bringup/rviz/fastlio2_navigation.rviz

tasks.label: Save Maps
args: -c
export COLCON_TRACE='' AMENT_TRACE_SETUP_FILES='' COLCON_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=$(command -v python3) && source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && ./scripts/save_maps.sh
tasks.detail: Runs scripts/save_maps.sh to call /pgo/save_maps (FASTLIO2 global map) and map_saver_cli on /projected_map, storing outputs under ${workspaceFolder}/maps/. Run after the FASTLIO2 Mapping Stack is producing data.

tasks.label: Launch: PiPER MoveIt Demo
args: -lc
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && DISPLAY=:${input:displayNumber} XAUTHORITY=$HOME/.Xauthority ros2 launch ranger_piper_moveit demo.launch.py
tasks.detail: MoveIt 2 demo with RViz on DISPLAY :77 for motion planning visualization (does not control physical arm)

tasks.label: Record: Rosbag (STCM Topics)
args: -lc

source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && mkdir -p ${workspaceFolder}/bags && cd ${workspaceFolder}/bags && ros2 bag record -s mcap -o ${input:bagName}_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S) /camera/image_raw /camera/camera_info /lidar_points_projected /livox/lidar /livox/imu /livox/imu_custom /fastlio2/lio_odom /tf /tf_static /robot_description
tasks.detail: Records STCM-relevant topics (RGB + camera info, projected LiDAR, raw LiDAR, IMU, FASTLIO2 odom, TF, robot_description) to an MCAP bag (uncompressed) under ${workspaceFolder}/bags/. Stop with Ctrl+C. Prompts for a base name; a timestamp suffix is appended automatically. Reference: ~27.7 GiB / 2m55s uncompressed on a full session.

tasks.label: Build: Clean and Recompile
args: -lc
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && rm -rf build install log && colcon build --symlink-install --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
tasks.detail: Removes build/install/log directories and performs a full clean rebuild with symlink install
